ops.text: Classical hardware decoders already operate at these latencies but pay for it in accuracy; the Kittiwake core, for instance, reaches a circuit-level threshold of $0.598\%$, compared with about $0.7\%$ for matching [⟦new.A8⟧], which leaves room for compact learned decoders that approach matching accuracy at comparable speed.
